early_errors.averaging: Within each sequence, average over its included prefixes1..32; then weight the 32 defined sequence averages equally. Sources without an included early prefix remain explicitly listed with undefined errors. Standard errors use the independent sequence averages.

source.depth_scope: independent coordinate depths; each shared across all coordinate rows

identification.criterion: sigma_min(AH)>=0.02; columns of A are the four component distributions; H has orthonormal columns perpendicular to the all-ones vector

uncertainty: One standard error across included independent source draws at each prefix. Raw component weights are used separately; component standard errors are not added.
interpretation: Means of specified predictive coefficients, not fractions of sequences with component dominance. Changing early inclusion prevents an unconditional transition-time conclusion.
